s: Din im ishsha yekola leareb ubo seip echad: ishto shel adam mearebet alayv mishshello shello middato, apillu im micha bah shello leareb, vaapillu eno ragil leareb immahem. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheoser alehem hechatzer im lo yeareb immahem, kegon sheen beto patuach ella lechatzer zo bilbad, veen lo derek acheret latzet mibbeto lirshut harabbim ella derek chatzer zo. Abal im hu patuach lishte chatzerot, beachat hu ragil latzet velabo tadir, sheoser alehem, ubeachat eno ragil latzet velabo tadir, sheeno oser alehem kelal ella sheasur letaltel mimmenna lebeto — beotah sheragil bah mearebet alayv ishto beal korcho, vaapillu enennu ragil leareb immahem, abal beotah sheeno ragil bah enah mearebet alayv beal korcho, ella im ken hu atzmo haya ragil leareb immahem. Abal im lo hurgal adayin leareb immahem, enam yekolim littol erubo shello meretzono birtzon ishto, kevan sheeno oser alehem. Vehu sheggilla dato beperush sheeno rotzeh. Abal kol zeman shello amar ken beperush — yekola ishto litten lahem erubo ap al pi sheeno oser alehem veeno ragil leareb immahem, lepi shemmin hassetam noach lo beerub ishto. Abal enah yekola lezakkot mishshello laacherim shello bidiato apillu libne chatzer sheoser alehem veragil leareb immahem. Abal yekola hi lezakkot lahem mimmezonoteha, shehu shellah. Veim en habbaal vehaishsha bair, yekolim bene habbayit leareb mishshello shello bidiato, shemmin hassetam lo yaqpid alehem. Vehu sheen habbayit patuach ella lechatzer achat, sheerub zeh bevadday zekut hu lo veen lo bo tzad choba, vezakin leadam shello middato. Abal im hu patuach lishte chatzerot — en kol achat mehen yekola leareb alayv mishshello mimmah shennotenim lah bene beto shello bidiato, ki erub zeh enennu zekut lo vadday, ki shemma lo yachpotz leareb im chatzer zo ella im zo. Umikkol maqom im hu ragil leareb beachat mehen, yekola hi leareb alayv shello middato mimmah shennotenim bene beto, ki min hassetam chapetz hu beerubah gam hayyom kemo ad atta. Abal mi sheereb kebar im bene hechatzer veerubo qayyam, veachar kak chazar bo meerubo — en chazarato kelum, veerubo erub beal korcho im oser alehem o sheragil leareb immahem. Abal im eno oser alehem veeno ragil leareb immahem, veereb immahem beaqray veachar kak chazar bo — hare nitbattel erubo, veim rotzeh lachazor uleareb, tzarik lachazor velizkot beerubo:
